notes: Only n_o and es_value_o assigned; all other fields are placeholders. Study 1 and PDF p. 5 (printed p. 782) identify the original primary work, but generic description Media priming does not specify which of three outcomes is intended. Candidate interaction coefficients b2 (unstandardized regression, Equation 1.1): general performance .07, p < .05; competence 0.00, ns; integrity -0.02, ns. No exact p is supplied for the latter two; do not pair their coefficients with p < .05. PDF confirms b2 where canonical OCR reads 62. Table 1 (p. 781) additionally prints separate-group unstandardized coefficients: general performance 0.10/0.27; competence 0.15/0.19; integrity 0.00/0.06 (no coverage/some coverage). These are distinct from the critical interaction coefficients and are not substituted. Analytic N unresolved: methods p. 780 reports 73 completers, whereas Tables 1 and 2 print no-coverage n=21 and some-coverage n=73. Rendered PDF pp. 3-5 confirms these printed numbers. Candidate arithmetic 21 + 73 = 94 concerns mutually exclusive exposure groups, but conflicts with the methods total and is not established as the analytic sample of the p. 782 interaction regressions. No N is extracted or inferred from df. Participants are Yale undergraduates; outcome-specific missingness/exclusions are not documented for the interaction regressions.
